name: Samvardhana Motherson
title: Press Release on the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

read.thesis: Record Q2 revenue Rs 38,280 Cr (+27% YoY) and booked business at USD 106 Bn, but H1 capex of Rs 3,585 Cr (56% of EBITDA) keeps the FY27 Rs 6,000 Cr outlay unchanged; no supply-discipline or utilisation signal disclosed.
